1. MAKE SURE YOU HAVE THE RAW GAME DUMP (GAME FOLDER, name looks like "CUSAXXXXX") NOT THE PKG FILE.
2. MAKE SURE YOU HAVE THE RAW GAME UPDATE FOLDER (GAME UPDATE FOLDER, name looks like "CUSAXXXXX-patch") NOT THE PKG FILE
3. If you want to extract your pkg files to turn them into raw dumps, watch https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rZ5jZToJVHE&t=2s for windows or https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DNJxUH2xWWY for linux.
4. Place both folders or the combined folder (update folder contents copied into base game folder) RIGHT NEXT TO Gravity Rush 2™.exe/AppImage.
5. Double click on Gravity Rush 2™.exe/AppImage and play the game
P.S. to add game to steam, just add the .exe/.AppImage as a non-steam game. To launch without the launcher, add -nolauncher in the launch options.

Thanks for playing!
